//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Grabby Mobs -> Config

Enable Grabby Mobs.//: Whether Grabby Mobs is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

mobsThatCanGrab.//: The mobs that always pick up items from the floor. Modded mobs can be added too, for example 'somemod:*'.

mobsGrabWhenMobGriefingIsOff.//: Whether the mobs still pick up items when the mobGriefing gamerule is off.

mobsDropGrabbedItemsOnDeath.//: Whether items a mob picked up drop when it dies. When disabled, those items are lost.

secondsBeforeRegrabbingAnItem.//: How many seconds a mob waits before picking up an item it let go of again. Set to 0 to turn this off. min: 0, max: 3,600
